items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: See the first jazz waltz ever written was about Fats Waller.

ctx.x: So when this was going on, was this – about what year was this?

Well that would have been – let’s see, as I said I recorded this stuff in 19 – I played it at the Monterey Festival. That was our big – that was our hit record. Milestones was our hit record too. I had Joe Pass – Joe Pass and all those guys in the band at that time. Had a heck of a band. My Blues for Yenya was popular, that was in – see I wrote the first – second jazz waltz ever written. See the first jazz waltz ever written was about Fats Waller.
